bites.title: The big six
bites.body: Six tools build most of the 3D models you've ever seen: extrude, inset, loop cut, bevel, merge, delete. Let's grow a tower.

bites.title: Extrude
bites.body: Face mode (3). Click the top face, press E, pull the mouse up, click. Brand new geometry grows out of the face.
bites.hint: Top face selected, then E. Move the mouse up, click to confirm.

bites.title: Again, exactly
bites.body: E again, then type 2 and press Enter. Two more meters of tower.

bites.title: Taper
bites.body: With the top face still selected, press S, type 0.5, press Enter. Pointy.

bites.title: Inset
bites.body: Press I and slide the mouse to inset the top face: a frame inside a frame. Click to confirm.
bites.hint: I, move the mouse toward the face center, click.

bites.title: Dig in
bites.body: E, then push the mouse down into the tower and click. Extrude works inward too. Instant pool.

bites.title: Loop cut
bites.body: Hover a side of the tower, press Ctrl+R. A yellow ring previews the cut. Click once, then right-click to drop it dead center.
bites.hint: Ctrl+R with the mouse over a side face edge. Click, then right-click.

bites.title: Bevel
bites.body: Press 2 for edges, click one sharp edge, press Ctrl+B and drag. Sharp corners become smooth chamfers. Scroll the wheel while dragging for more segments.

bites.title: Merge
bites.body: Press 1 for vertices. Click one corner, Shift+click a neighbor, press M and choose At Center. Two points become one.
bites.hint: M opens the Merge menu. At Center is first.

bites.title: Delete
bites.body: Press 3 for faces, click any face, press X and choose Faces. A hole! Meshes don't have to be closed.

bites.title: Step back
bites.body: Tab back to Object Mode and orbit around your creation.

bites.title: Lesson 06: cleared
bites.body:
Extrude, inset, loop cut, bevel, merge, delete. Honestly, that's most of modeling. Everything else is practice and taste.

Scroll on for Lesson 07: modifiers that work while you sleep.
